description: Switch the prediction gate on or off for one agent. Required: agent_id, enabled. When on, any tool that CHANGES something is refused until the agent has logged an open episode with a prediction and a confidence; reading, ask_human and the recording tools stay free, and an open episode expires after an hour. Off by default — turn it on for one agent first and look at whether the predictions are worth anything before making it the rule.
name: set_prediction_gate
